verses.original: Λέγω οὖν ὁ Θεὸς μὴ ἀπώσατο αὐτοῦ τὸν λαὸν μὴ γένοιτο γὰρ ἐγὼ εἰμί Ἰσραηλίτης καὶ ἐκ σπέρματος Ἀβραάμ φυλῆς Βενιαμίν
verses.transliteration: Legō oun ho Theos mē apōsato autou ton laon mē genoito gar egō eimi Israēlitēs kai ek spermatos Abraam phylēs Beniamin
verses.literal: I ask then - {did} God vvv reject His - people vvv Certainly not - I am an Israelite [myself] vvv a descendant of Abraham from [the] tribe of Benjamin

verses.original: ὁ Θεὸς οὐκ ἀπώσατο αὐτοῦ τὸν λαὸν ὃν προέγνω ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε τί ἡ γραφή λέγει ἐν Ἠλίᾳ ὡς ἐντυγχάνει τῷ Θεῷ κατὰ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: ho Theos ouk apōsato autou ton laon hon proegnō ē ouk oidate ti hē graphē legei en Ēlia hōs entynchanei tō Theō kata tou Israēl
verses.literal: - God vvv did not reject His - people whom He foreknew - vvv Do you not know what the Scripture says about Elijah how he appealed - to God against - Israel

verses.original: Κύριε ἀπέκτειναν σου τοὺς προφήτας κατέσκαψαν σου τὰ θυσιαστήριά κἀγὼ μόνος ὑπελείφθην καὶ ζητοῦσιν μου τὴν ψυχήν
verses.transliteration: Kyrie apekteinan sou tous prophētas kateskapsan sou ta thysiastēria kagō monos hypeleiphthēn kai zētousin mou tēn psychēn
verses.literal: Lord they have killed Your - prophets [and] torn down Your - altars I [am] the only one left and they are seeking my - life [ as well ]

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ τί ὁ χρηματισμός λέγει αὐτῷ Κατέλιπον ἐμαυτῷ ἑπτακισχιλίους ἄνδρας οἵτινες οὐκ ἔκαμψαν γόνυ τῇ Βάαλ
verses.transliteration: Alla ti ho chrēmatismos legei autō Katelipon emautō heptakischilious andras hoitines ouk ekampsan gony tē Baal
verses.literal: [And] what [was] the divine reply . . . to him I have reserved for Myself seven thousand men who {have} not bowed [the] knee - to Baal

verses.original: Οὕτως οὖν καὶ ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ γέγονεν λεῖμμα κατ’ ἐκλογὴν χάριτος
verses.transliteration: Houtōs oun kai en tō nyn kairō gegonen leimma kat’ eklogēn charitos
verses.literal: In the same way . . . . . . at the present time there is a remnant vvv chosen by grace

verses.original: δὲ εἰ χάριτι οὐκέτι ἐξ ἔργων ἐπεὶ ἡ χάρις οὐκέτι γίνεται χάρις
verses.transliteration: de ei chariti ouketi ex ergōn epei hē charis ouketi ginetai charis
verses.literal: And if [it is] by grace [then it is] no longer by works Otherwise - grace {would} no longer be grace

verses.original: Τί οὖν ὃ Ἰσραήλ ἐπιζητεῖ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐπέτυχεν δὲ ἡ ἐκλογὴ ἐπέτυχεν δὲ οἱ λοιποὶ ἐπωρώθησαν
verses.transliteration: Ti oun ho Israēl epizētei touto ouk epetychen de hē eklogē epetychen de hoi loipoi epōrōthēsan
verses.literal: What then What Israel was seeking - vvv it failed to obtain but the elect [did] - The others were hardened

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται ὁ Θεὸς Ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς πνεῦμα κατανύξεως ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν καὶ ὦτα τοῦ μὴ ἀκούειν ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai ho Theos Edōken autois pneuma katanyxeōs ophthalmous tou mē blepein kai ōta tou mē akouein heōs tēs sēmeron hēmeras
verses.literal: as it is written - God gave them a spirit of stupor eyes that vvv could not see and ears that vvv could not hear to - this very day . . .

verses.original: Καὶ Δαυὶδ λέγει αὐτῶν ἡ τράπεζα Γενηθήτω εἰς παγίδα καὶ εἰς θήραν καὶ εἰς σκάνδαλον καὶ εἰς ἀνταπόδομα αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai Dauid legei autōn hē trapeza Genēthētō eis pagida kai eis thēran kai eis skandalon kai eis antapodoma autois
verses.literal: And David says {May} their - table become . . . a snare and - a trap - - a stumbling block and - a retribution to them

verses.original: αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ σκοτισθήτωσαν μὴ τοῦ βλέπειν καὶ αὐτῶν τὸν νῶτον σύνκαμψον διὰ παντὸς
verses.transliteration: autōn hoi ophthalmoi skotisthētōsan mē tou blepein kai autōn ton nōton synkampson dia pantos
verses.literal: {May} their - eyes be darkened vvv vvv [so] they cannot see and their - backs be bent vvv forever

verses.original: Λέγω οὖν μὴ ἔπταισαν ἵνα πέσωσιν μὴ γένοιτο ἀλλὰ τῷ αὐτῶν παραπτώματι ἡ σωτηρία τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εἰς τὸ παραζηλῶσαι αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Legō oun mē eptaisan hina pesōsin mē genoito alla tō autōn paraptōmati hē sōtēria tois ethnesin eis to parazēlōsai autous
verses.literal: I ask then vvv did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery vvv Certainly not However because of their trespass - salvation [has come] to the Gentiles to - make [Israel] jealous . . .

verses.original: δὲ εἰ αὐτῶν τὸ παράπτωμα πλοῦτος κόσμου καὶ αὐτῶν τὸ ἥττημα πλοῦτος ἐθνῶν πόσῳ μᾶλλον αὐτῶν τὸ πλήρωμα
verses.transliteration: de ei autōn to paraptōma ploutos kosmou kai autōn to hēttēma ploutos ethnōn posō mallon autōn to plērōma
verses.literal: But if their - trespass [means] riches for [the] world and their - failure [means] riches for [the] Gentiles how much greater [ riches ] {will} their - fullness [bring]

verses.original: δὲ λέγω Ὑμῖν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐφ’ μὲν ὅσον οὖν ἐγὼ εἰμι ἀπόστολος ἐθνῶν δοξάζω μου τὴν διακονίαν
verses.transliteration: de legō Hymin tois ethnesin eph’ men hoson oun egō eimi apostolos ethnōn doxazō mou tēn diakonian
verses.literal: - I am speaking to you - Gentiles Inasmuch . . . . . . . . . {as} I am [the] apostle to [the] Gentiles I magnify my - ministry

verses.original: εἴ πως παραζηλώσω μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ σώσω τινὰς ἐξ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: ei pōs parazēlōsō mou tēn sarka kai sōsō tinas ex autōn
verses.literal: in the hope that . . . I may provoke my [own] people {to jealousy} and save some of them

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ αὐτῶν ἡ ἀποβολὴ καταλλαγὴ κόσμου τίς ἡ πρόσλημψις εἰ μὴ ζωὴ ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: gar ei autōn hē apobolē katallagē kosmou tis hē proslēmpsis ei mē zōē ek nekrōn
verses.literal: For if their - rejection [is the] reconciliation of [the] world what [will their] acceptance [be] but . . . life from [the] dead

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ἡ ἀπαρχὴ ἁγία καὶ τὸ φύραμα καὶ εἰ ἡ ῥίζα ἁγία καὶ οἱ κλάδοι
verses.transliteration: de ei hē aparchē hagia kai to phyrama kai ei hē rhiza hagia kai hoi kladoi
verses.literal: - If the first part [of the dough] [is] holy so [is] the whole batch - if the root [is] holy so [are] the branches

verses.original: δέ Εἰ τινες τῶν κλάδων ἐξεκλάσθησαν δὲ σὺ ὢν ἀγριέλαιος ἐνεκεντρίσθης ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐγένου συνκοινωνὸς τῆς πιότητος τῆς τῆς ἐλαίας ῥίζης
verses.transliteration: de Ei tines tōn kladōn exeklasthēsan de sy ōn agrielaios enekentristhēs en autois kai egenou synkoinōnos tēs piotētos tēs tēs elaias rhizēs
verses.literal: Now if some - branches have been broken off and you - a wild olive shoot have been grafted in among [the others] - vvv to share in the nourishment - of the olive root

verses.original: μὴ κατακαυχῶ τῶν κλάδων δὲ εἰ κατακαυχᾶσαι σὺ οὐ βαστάζεις τὴν ῥίζαν ἀλλὰ ἡ ῥίζα σέ
verses.transliteration: mē katakauchō tōn kladōn de ei katakauchasai sy ou bastazeis tēn rhizan alla hē rhiza se
verses.literal: {do} not boast over those branches - If [you do, remember this] You {do} not support the root but the root [ supports ] you

verses.original: Ἐρεῖς οὖν κλάδοι Ἐξεκλάσθησαν ἵνα ἐγὼ ἐγκεντρισθῶ
verses.transliteration: Ereis oun kladoi Exeklasthēsan hina egō enkentristhō
verses.literal: You will say then Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in

verses.original: καλῶς ἐξεκλάσθησαν τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ δὲ σὺ ἕστηκας τῇ πίστει μὴ ὑψηλὰ φρόνει ἀλλὰ φοβοῦ
verses.transliteration: kalōs exeklasthēsan tē apistia de sy hestēkas tē pistei mē hypsēla phronei alla phobou
verses.literal: That is correct They were broken off because of unbelief but you stand - by faith {Do} not be arrogant . . . but be afraid

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ ὁ Θεὸς οὐκ ἐφείσατο τῶν κατὰ φύσιν κλάδων μή πως φείσεται σοῦ οὐδὲ
verses.transliteration: gar ei ho Theos ouk epheisato tōn kata physin kladōn mē pōs pheisetai sou oude
verses.literal: For if - God {did} not spare the vvv natural branches {He will} certainly not - spare you [either]

verses.original: ἴδε οὖν χρηστότητα καὶ ἀποτομίαν Θεοῦ ἀποτομία μὲν ἐπὶ τοὺς πεσόντας δὲ χρηστότης Θεοῦ ἐπὶ σὲ ἐὰν ἐπιμένῃς τῇ χρηστότητι ἐπεὶ σὺ καὶ ἐκκοπήσῃ
verses.transliteration: Ide oun chrēstotēta kai apotomian Theou apotomia men epi tous pesontas de chrēstotēs Theou epi se ean epimenēs tē chrēstotēti epei sy kai ekkopēsē
verses.literal: Take notice therefore [of the] kindness and severity of God severity - to those who fell but kindness - to you if you continue in [His] kindness Otherwise you also will be cut off

verses.original: δέ ἐὰν κἀκεῖνοι μὴ ἐπιμένωσιν τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ ἐνκεντρισθήσονται γάρ ὁ Θεὸς ἐστιν δυνατὸς ἐνκεντρίσαι αὐτούς πάλιν
verses.transliteration: de ean kakeinoi mē epimenōsin tē apistia enkentristhēsontai gar ho Theos estin dynatos enkentrisai autous palin
verses.literal: And if they vvv do not persist - in unbelief they will be grafted in for - God is able to graft them {in} again

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ σὺ ἐξεκόπης ἐκ τῆς κατὰ φύσιν ἀγριελαίου καὶ παρὰ φύσιν ἐνεκεντρίσθης εἰς καλλιέλαιον πόσῳ μᾶλλον οὗτοι οἱ κατὰ φύσιν ἐνκεντρισθήσονται τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἐλαίᾳ
verses.transliteration: gar ei sy exekopēs ek tēs kata physin agrielaiou kai para physin enekentristhēs eis kallielaion posō mallon houtoi hoi kata physin enkentristhēsontai tē idia elaia
verses.literal: For if you were cut from - vvv vvv a wild olive tree and contrary to nature were grafted into [one that is] cultivated how much more [ readily ] {will} these the vvv natural [branches] be grafted into [their] own olive tree

verses.original: γὰρ Οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν τοῦτο τὸ μυστήριον ἀδελφοί ἵνα μὴ ἦτε φρόνιμοι ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ὅτι πώρωσις ἀπὸ μέρους γέγονεν Ἰσραὴλ τῷ ἄχρι οὗ τὸ πλήρωμα τῶν ἐθνῶν εἰσέλθῃ
verses.transliteration: gar Ou thelō hymas agnoein touto to mystērion adelphoi hina mē ēte phronimoi en heautois hoti pōrōsis apo merous gegonen Israēl tō achri hou to plērōma tōn ethnōn eiselthē
verses.literal: - vvv I do not want you to be ignorant of this - mystery brothers so that vvv you will not be conceited . . . . . . - A hardening in part has come to Israel - until . . . the full number of the Gentiles has come in

verses.original: καὶ οὕτως πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ σωθήσεται καθὼς γέγραπται ὁ Ῥυόμενος Ἥξει ἐκ Σιὼν ἀποστρέψει ἀσεβείας ἀπὸ Ἰακώβ
verses.transliteration: kai houtōs pas Israēl sōthēsetai kathōs gegraptai ho Rhyomenos Hēxei ek Siōn apostrepsei asebeias apo Iakōb
verses.literal: And so all Israel will be saved as it is written The Deliverer will come from Zion He will remove godlessness from Jacob

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἡ παρ’ ἐμοῦ διαθήκη αὐτοῖς ὅταν ἀφέλωμαι αὐτῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: kai hautē hē par’ emou diathēkē autois hotan aphelōmai autōn tas hamartias
verses.literal: And this [is] - vvv My covenant with them when I take away their - sins

verses.original: μὲν Κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἐχθροὶ δι’ ὑμᾶς δὲ κατὰ τὴν ἐκλογὴν ἀγαπητοὶ διὰ τοὺς πατέρας
verses.transliteration: men Kata to euangelion echthroi di’ hymas de kata tēn eklogēn agapētoi dia tous pateras
verses.literal: - Regarding the gospel [they are] enemies on your account . . . but regarding - election [they are] loved on account of the patriarchs

verses.original: γὰρ τὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ χαρίσματα καὶ ἡ κλῆσις ἀμεταμέλητα
verses.transliteration: gar ta tou Theou charismata kai hē klēsis ametamelēta
verses.literal: For - vvv God’s gifts and [His] call [are] irrevocable

verses.original: γὰρ Ὥσπερ ὑμεῖς ποτε ἠπειθήσατε τῷ Θεῷ δὲ νῦν ἠλεήθητε τούτων τῇ ἀπειθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: gar Hōsper hymeis pote ēpeithēsate tō Theō de nyn ēleēthēte toutōn tē apeitheia
verses.literal: - Just as you [who] formerly disobeyed - God - vvv have now received mercy through their - disobedience

verses.original: οὕτως οὗτοι καὶ νῦν ἠπείθησαν ἵνα αὐτοὶ καὶ νῦν ἐλεηθῶσιν τῷ ἐλέει ὑμετέρῳ
verses.transliteration: houtōs houtoi kai nyn ēpeithēsan hina autoi kai nyn eleēthōsin tō eleei hymeterō
verses.literal: so they too vvv have now disobeyed in order that they too {may} now receive mercy through the mercy [shown to] you

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς συνέκλεισεν τοὺς πάντας εἰς ἀπείθειαν ἵνα ἐλεήσῃ τοὺς πάντας
verses.transliteration: gar ho Theos synekleisen tous pantas eis apeitheian hina eleēsē tous pantas
verses.literal: For - God has consigned - everyone to disobedience so that He may have mercy on - everyone

verses.original: Ὦ βάθος πλούτου καὶ σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως Θεοῦ ὡς ἀνεξεραύνητα αὐτοῦ τὰ κρίματα καὶ ἀνεξιχνίαστοι αὐτοῦ αἱ ὁδοὶ
verses.transliteration: Ō bathos ploutou kai sophias kai gnōseōs Theou hōs anexeraunēta autou ta krimata kai anexichniastoi autou hai hodoi
verses.literal: O [the] depth of [the] riches - of [the] wisdom and knowledge of God How unsearchable [are] His - judgments and untraceable His - ways

verses.original: γὰρ Τίς ἔγνω νοῦν Κυρίου ἢ τίς ἐγένετο αὐτοῦ σύμβουλος
verses.transliteration: gar Tis egnō noun Kyriou ē tis egeneto autou symboulos
verses.literal: - Who has known [the] mind of [the] Lord Or who has been His counselor

verses.original: Ἢ τίς προέδωκεν αὐτῷ καὶ ἀνταποδοθήσεται αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Ē tis proedōken autō kai antapodothēsetai autō
verses.literal: - Who has first given to God that God should repay him

verses.original: ὅτι ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: hoti ex autou kai di’ autou kai eis auton ta panta autō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas amēn
verses.literal: For from Him and through Him and to Him - [are] all things To Him [be] the glory vvv vvv forever Amen
